newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index rallies to set another record.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index rallies to set another record.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rallied to set another record Wednesday, overcoming a bout of profit-taking that had sent blue chips lower earlier in the day.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow closed up 16.03 points at 6,020.81, which beat Monday's record finish of 6,010.00. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a slim margin on another heavy volume of 443 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
